svg.title: Kern Fig. 17 — caloric temperature factor F_c
svg.text: Kern Fig. 17 — caloric temperature factor Fc
Fc against Δtc/Δth, one curve per Kc (redrawn from Kern Eq. 5.28)
Tc = T₂ + Fc(T₁ − T₂); tc = t₁ + Fc(t₂ − t₁)
Mark Δtc/Δth = 100/220 = 0.455 on the (log) horizontal axis.
Go straight up to the Kc = 0.20 curve (crude oil controlling).
Go across to the Fc axis.
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
